foundation.overturn_when: A concrete application needs durable multi-host state/replay (Temporal), explicit graph checkpoints (LangGraph), a remote/container worker (OpenHands SDK) or programmatic Claude session control (Claude Agent SDK), and a matched comparison passes.
foundation.title: Agent SDKs and runtime workers

foundation.overturn_when: A specific dependency/update or vulnerability gap is demonstrated and one alternative covers it with pinned database/provenance, manageable findings and no duplicate ownership of the same dependency.
foundation.title: CI and supply chain

foundation.overturn_when: A sealed task set in the target languages shows a challenger returning more correct source/references at an acceptable total indexing, retrieval and maintenance cost.
foundation.title: Code navigation

foundation.overturn_when: A sealed representative corpus/query set shows useful quality gains with acceptable repeated end-to-end latency, or layout/OCR failures justify a separately qualified parser.
foundation.title: Documents and ingestion

foundation.overturn_when: An isolated representative corpus and question set shows better source-grounded recall/usefulness and acceptable complete provider use, latency, capture/deletion and restore behavior without ambiguous memory ownership.
foundation.title: Durable memory

foundation.overturn_when: A concrete cross-repository or multi-host Git/GitHub workflow needs capabilities beyond gh/worktrunk/difftastic, and a challenger passes a matched comparison.
foundation.title: Git practice and GitHub automation

foundation.overturn_when: A defined production, remote-team or GPU deployment requirement exceeds the local fixture, and one alternative passes its account, data, networking, rollback and workload-cost acceptance.
foundation.title: Application and service hosting

foundation.overturn_when: A specific task exposes a missing procedure, and a pinned candidate works in native discovery and task execution with less conflict or better measured results than the current procedure.
foundation.title: Instructions and skills

foundation.overturn_when: Untrusted code or a deployment target requires a stronger VM/OCI boundary, and the selected alternative passes workload, network, resource, cleanup and host compatibility checks.
foundation.title: Isolation

foundation.overturn_when: A concrete MCP surface gap needs a new server, and a reviewed registry entry passes the same bridge/inspection acceptance as mcporter/mcp-inspector.
foundation.title: MCP servers and client surfaces

foundation.overturn_when: A required structured-event, custom-tool or application state capability is unavailable through the native path and a supported SDK implementation passes the same task, account, effect and recovery checks.
foundation.title: Native clients

foundation.overturn_when: A required trace, evaluation or supported model/hardware workload is unanswerable by the current path, and one alternative passes privacy, fidelity, latency/cost and recovery comparisons without duplicate capture.
foundation.title: Observation and optional inference

foundation.overturn_when: A defined tool-use/extraction or experiment-tracking requirement cannot be expressed adequately in the current test lane and a challenger passes a representative frozen oracle with usable failure inspection.
foundation.title: Quality and evaluation

foundation.overturn_when: A real multi-language/system dependency or state-loss case exceeds the selected recipes, and the proposed environment/backup alternative passes install, restore, resume and cleanup on the target host.
foundation.title: Recovery and portability

foundation.overturn_when: Real jobs require host-loss survival, days-long waits or durable cross-host effects, and one challenger passes the declared effect/retry/recovery cases with acceptable operational burden.
foundation.title: Scheduling and supervision

foundation.overturn_when: A concrete multi-host or multi-operator secret-sharing need appears, and openbao (or a comparable secret manager) passes an actual installed/queried comparison against the native-login-only policy.
foundation.title: Secrets and credentials

foundation.overturn_when: A sealed project/domain retrieval set shows improved source-grounded quality and acceptable latency, memory and lifecycle costs, or a supported target model cannot run in the current service.
foundation.title: Semantic code retrieval

foundation.overturn_when: A frozen task/artifact and repeated controlled comparison improves answer correctness or retrieval completeness while reducing complete provider use or latency, with successful raw-input recovery.
foundation.title: Context and usage efficiency

foundation.overturn_when: A defined source-coverage or ingestion task exceeds the current commands and a candidate improves attributable retrieval completeness, accuracy and total runtime/cost on the same frozen source set.
foundation.title: Web research

foundation.overturn_when: A real task needs durable multi-host state, approval waits or effect recovery beyond native workers, and one challenger passes frozen cancellation, replay, ownership and integration cases.
foundation.title: Workers and task ownership

us-equities.overturn_when: Run a preregistered, representative held-out financial/document and code retrieval set at the same context budget; replace or supplement a lane only if a candidate improves source/answer fidelity, abstention and measured task cost while preserving isolation, exact source recovery and native client behavior.
